answer: An attacker spinning up N fake participants must pay N bonds plus attestation costs, making the delta between honest and sybil cost steep. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation slot: each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and joining requires a fresh proof-of-personhood attestation. Reputation earned at the mesa of trust decays if unverified, while a verified oasis of peers vouches for newcomers, so cheap identities never reach influence. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
